REFERENCE PRIORITY: image 4 (the accepted T01 asset) defines the exact family DNA, FRONT and shape language. Image 5, when supplied, is the accepted immediate predecessor. Images 1-3 are MATERIAL/PALETTE inspiration only; NEVER copy their whole buildings, props, layout or lighting. Render exactly the current tier described below, not the style-reference scene. Never add boxes, crates, loose props or extra symbols. All lamps OFF, all glass non-emissive, no glow. Thick rounded clean forms, broad painted color areas.

TARGETED T05 GEOMETRY AND MATERIAL: Use image 5 as the exact T04 base. Add one clearly substantial permanent side hall on the right/rear of the two tanks, attached to the rear workshop. Its visible outer wall is broad SMOOTH WARM CREAM PLASTER with rounded masonry corners, a thick sage base band and two large dark window panels; NO WOOD PLANK LINES on this new hall. A low rounded corrugated roof makes its whole new volume readable. Keep the original patched-timber gabled front, canopy, rear workshop and two tanks recognizable. The new broad plaster side hall must visibly contrast with the old timber hall; this is the first permanent community masonry expansion. Pull camera back for at least 10 percent clear border around every extremity.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one final Meshy image-to-3D building reference for Weedtopia Inc / Burning Hills.
Subject: harvest refinement building, T05_L050. Exact visible state: permanent plaster side hall.
Family DNA: soft gabled hall, rounded refinement tank on local +X, broad harvest portal. Function: harvest refinement building.
Progression: Preserve the T01 family DNA and the previously accepted tier. Integrate previous functional capacity compactly upward and rearward, inside the reserved parcel. Current cumulative architectural milestones: one repaired hall with one round refinement tank; second large refinement tank; wide roofed harvest intake portal; rear workshop wing; permanent plaster side hall. No separate freestanding buildings: all wings and modules are structurally attached.
Scale: maximum reserved parcel 18m local X by 16m local Z, maximum family height 28m. This reserved envelope is NOT a visible base. See asset_spec.de.md for this tier's approximate occupied dimensions; render the whole current object, not an empty full-size plot.
Front and camera: local +Y up, front facing +Z, front stays on the lower-left visible face of the image, local +X side on lower-right. Camera at local (+X,+Y,+Z), about 35 degrees elevated, near orthographic 3/4 front view. Never mirror. Ground-center pivot intent; future growth is upward and toward local -Z. The entry and delivery zones stay on +Z.
Materials: warm plaster, sage enamel, aged corrugated metal, brass; epoch treatment: warm plaster, reclaimed wood, sage enamel, first permanent service modules. Broad hand-painted color areas and large restrained wear patches. Rounded/beveled silhouettes, thick reconstructable parts, modular retro technology, one or at most two eventual material slots. Green glass must be thick and legible. At most one dominant botanical or grinder motif.
Reference input roles: Image 1 Reclaimed Green Haven gives warm rebuilt shapes and readability; image 2 Herbal Atom Age gives rounded enamel machines and copper/brass; image 3 Burning Hills Afterglow gives hopeful worldbuilding only, NOT its dusk lighting, environment or people. Additional inputs, when present: the family's accepted T01 geometry anchor, then its immediately preceding accepted tier. Preserve their family identity, front and proportions while making the specified large upgrade visible. For T00 use only the intact T01 as extra geometry reference. For T01 or T_FIXED only the three style inputs are supplied.
Composition: exactly one single complete freestanding asset, centered and grounded; square 1024x1024 or larger, generous 10 percent clear margin all around. Plain solid very light warm-gray/off-white background. Neutral even studio light; one soft contact shadow only. All geometry entirely visible.
Technical intent: stylized game-ready smart-topology, clean edges, minimal geometry; no floating parts. Attached architectural planting is allowed; no loose props. A park may contain its intrinsic bounded planted parcel, never a surrounding scenic diorama.
Exclude: people, characters, vehicles, conveyor belts, surrounding scene, landscape, city, unrelated buildings, loose props, diorama ground, text, readable signs, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, weapons, gore, smoking, smoke, particles, thin antennae, tangled cables, clipped or cropped geometry, baked dramatic shadows, glows, fog or dusk color casts.
review_notes: Visually accepted corrected T05: large structurally attached right/rear hall now has broad smooth cream plaster walls, sage base and rounded corrugated roof; strong community masonry expansion clearly contrasts with retained patched timber core. Front canopy, rear workshop and both tanks retained. Neutral studio with entire asset visible; no people text props scene or glow.
